mechanisms.behavior: Four balls initialize on occupancy switches 18-21. Output 1 ejects the rightmost ball through jam opto 22 toward shooter switch 23. Keep each ball's identity and occupancy through drains and ejections.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: The machine retains a manual plunger. Output 2 also launches a ball resting on shooter-lane switch 23 when the ROM requests an automatic serve.
mechanisms.label: Manual shooter with auto launcher

mechanisms.behavior: Output 3 energizes the magnet near the AMP suit. The proven table uses a non-centering magnet, so magnetic force influences a nearby steel ball without teleporting it to the magnet center.
mechanisms.label: AMP suit magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Targets 42-44 move together. Switch 46 is fully raised and switch 45 fully lowered. The proven table moves from Z 25 to -24 in 25 steps and disables target collision while down.
mechanisms.label: Motorized AMP three-target bank

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 14 reports a ball at the Link lock. Output 6 raises the lock pins and output 7 releases or drops the latch. Recreate the physical barriers and ball retention; the associated Jake/Link cover animation is cosmetic.
mechanisms.label: Link lockup lift and latch

mechanisms.behavior: Output 19 powers the suit motor and relay 13 selects direction. Switch 57 is the down endpoint and 58 the up endpoint.
mechanisms.label: Motorized AMP suit

mechanisms.behavior: One captive ball travels within its constrained lane and pulses normally-closed switch 39 on impact. The proven table creates one captive ball, not two.
mechanisms.label: Captive ball

mechanisms.behavior: Outputs 15/16 drive the left/right flippers. Dedicated public pairs 84/83 and 82/81 are the cabinet button and normally-closed EOS contacts respectively.
mechanisms.label: Lower flippers

mechanisms.behavior: The left, right, and bottom pop bumpers use output/switch pairs 9/30, 10/31, and 11/32. Each switch hit drives the corresponding physical kick ring through ROM control.
mechanisms.label: Three pop bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: Left and right slingshots use output/switch pairs 17/26 and 18/27.
mechanisms.label: Lower slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: Output 8 drives the 16 VAC shaker. It is optional on Pro and factory-included on Limited Edition.
mechanisms.label: Shaker motor
